exposure: Threshold percentage of elevated glucose values for pharmacotherapy initiation (20-39% vs. ≥40% of capillary blood glucose values above goal)
outcome: Composite GDM-associated neonatal adverse outcome (macrosomia, LGA, shoulder dystocia, hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia requiring phototherapy, respiratory distress syndrome, stillbirth, neonatal demise)
cohort: 417 women with GDM delivering in a single tertiary care center
finding: Initiating pharmacotherapy for GDM when 20-39% of capillary blood glucose values are above goal, compared to ≥40%, was associated with decreased rates of adverse neonatal outcomes but increased rates of SGA.
